## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] UI smoke test passes when UI/controller code changed
- [ ] QML lint passes when QML changed
- [ ] Resolve Free path considered when launcher/handoff/apply code changed
- [ ] Resolve Studio path considered when bridge/apply code changed
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, footage, session data or generated build artifacts are committed

## Notes

Include relevant Resolve version, GPU/backend details, screenshots or logs when they help review the change.
